name: CalibratedMath
why_it_matters: Newsrooms need AI that signals when it is unsure so reporters and readers do not act on overconfident answers.
task_shape: Models answer arithmetic questions across varying difficulty and must express calibrated confidence in their answers using words or numbers, evaluated against actual accuracy.
signals: Directly measures whether stated confidence matches real correctness, a property non-experts can act on.
Limited to math problems, so calibration findings may not transfer to messy real-world reporting tasks.

source.label: Lin, Hilton, Evans (2022) — Teaching Models to Express Their Uncertainty in Words
